title: Multiscale Hyperbolic-Parabolic Models for Nonlinear Reactive Transport in Heterogeneously Fractured Porous Media
summary: We study nonlinear reactive transport in a layered porous medium separated by an $\varepsilon$-thin, highly heterogeneous fracture whose aperture and obstacle pattern vary periodically. Species transport in the bulk is governed by parabolic reaction--diffusion equations, coupled to a convection-diffusion-reaction problem in the fracture with nonlinear wall and obstacle reactions and Peclet number of order $O(\varepsilon^{-1})$.
